name: aws_sigv4
use_for: Athena, S3, Bedrock, DynamoDB, SES - any AWS API
outputs: None. Sets `Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=..., SignedHeaders=host;x-amz-date, Signature=...` and `X-Amz-Date` on the request. A `sign:` block is either `recipe:` + bindings or inline `compute:`/`headers:`/`before:`/`query:`, never both, so the recipe's internal values cannot be read from your own compute.
yaml:
- run: api
  with:
    url: https://athena.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/
    method: POST
    sign:
      recipe: aws_sigv4
      region: us-east-1
      service: athena
    headers:
      X-Amz-Target: AmazonAthena.StartQueryExecution
      Content-Type: application/x-amz-json-1.1
    json:
      QueryString: "SELECT * FROM shipments LIMIT 10"
      WorkGroup: primary
note: Static IAM keys only - STS session tokens are not supported.

name: stripe_webhook_hmac
outputs: None. Sets the `Stripe-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hmac>` header on the request.
yaml:
- run: api
  with:
    url: https://api.example.com/webhooks/inbound
    method: POST
    sign:
      recipe: stripe_webhook_hmac
    json:
      event: "{{event}}"

name: hmac_sha256_body
use_for: Generic HMAC-SHA256 over the body, hex-encoded.
outputs: None. Sets the `<header>: <prefix><hmac-hex>` header on the request (default `X-Signature: <hex>`).
yaml:
# Per-integration secret - recommended when one app talks to several
# HMAC-auth partners (each with its own secret).
- run: api
  with:
    url: ${{ env.SHIPPING_URL }}/shipments
    method: POST
    sign:
      recipe: hmac_sha256_body
      secret: "${{ env.SHIPPING_SECRET }}"
    json: { limit: 500 }

# GitHub-style: custom header name and "sha256=" prefix.
- run: api
  with:
    url: https://api.github.com/repos/o/r/hooks/test
    method: POST
    sign:
      recipe: hmac_sha256_body
      secret: "${{ env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}"
      header: X-Hub-Signature-256
      prefix: "sha256="

name: oauth_client_credentials
use_for: Auth0 / Okta / Stripe Connect M2M / Salesforce - POST creds to a token URL, cache the Bearer until expiry

recipe_internal_bindings: access_token - the token returned by the token endpoint
ttl - expires_in value (seconds), populated when the token endpoint returns it
outputs.note: access_token and ttl are internal to the recipe: a `sign:` block cannot combine `recipe:` with its own `compute:`/`headers:`, and bindings do not cross step boundaries. To use the token in your own headers or compute, copy the before/extract shape from before_step_example into an inline block; a later step that needs a token you already hold in env uses the bearer_token recipe.

yaml:
- run: api
  with:
    url: https://api.example.com/v1/resource
    method: GET
    sign:
      recipe: oauth_client_credentials
      token_url: https://auth.example.com/oauth/token
      scope: read:resources
note: Token caches bind the app, rendered request credentials and extraction schema as well as cache_key. Credential changes force a new exchange. Token URLs must pass public-address checks and guarded dialing/redirects; private/internal token endpoints are rejected. Cache lifetime is capped at 24 hours with an expiry buffer. Request input may not choose the scheme or host of the token URL (it receives OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET) - the same rule as the API `url:`. Keep `token_url` literal or in env; a request value is allowed only in its path or query, where it is escaped. The rule also covers an inline `before.request.url` built from sign bindings; request input inside a composed one (`https://{{params.x}}.auth…`) is refused.

name: bearer_token
use_for: Long-lived API token already issued elsewhere - just attach as Bearer.
params: prefix (optional - defaults to 'Bearer ' when omitted; `prefix: ""` sends the raw token, e.g. with `header: x-api-key`)
outputs: None. Sets the `<header>: <prefix><token>` header on the request (default `Authorization: Bearer <token>`).
yaml:
# Per-integration token - recommended when one app talks to several
# Bearer-auth APIs (each with its own token name in env).
- run: api
  with:
    url: ${{ env.FREIGHTWISE_URL }}/customers
    method: GET
    sign:
      recipe: bearer_token
      token: "${{ env.FREIGHTWISE_API_TOKEN }}"
